spots.name: Cape Flattery Lighthouse
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Flattery Rocks National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Makah Peaks
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 501 m (1,644 ft).

spots.name: Wedding Rock Petroglyphs
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Titacoclos Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 21 m (69 ft) tall.
